iau13.publisher: Institut Paris Region (IAU îdF), Le fonctionnement des grandes gares ferroviaires à Paris, Londres, Berlin et Madrid, November 2013
iau13.about: Paris terminals at the 8 to 9 morning peak (2012-13): Montparnasse 16 high-speed trains on tracks 1 to 9, Gare de Lyon 14, Gare du Nord saturated except the Eurostar tracks, Gare de l'Est about one train per track per hour

cgi17.publisher: Report to the Commissaire général à l'investissement, counter-assessment of the Paris to Lyon high-speed line capacity project, December 2017
cgi17.about: Paris to Lyon line limited to 13 paths an hour each way, 16 with new signalling by 2030; at Gare de Lyon, turnarounds at the platform must fall from 55 to 40 minutes

sma19.publisher: SMA, Projet Gare du Nord: avis d'expert, for the City of Paris, 17 December 2019
sma19.about: Gare du Nord: at most 15 of the 19 main-line tracks needed at the peak by the timetable

senat02.publisher: French Senate, written question 01833, ministry's answer, 2002
senat02.about: Gare du Nord: no further trains can be accepted; tracks and approach are full

cgpc04.publisher: Conseil général des ponts et chaussées, report 2004-0085-01
cgpc04.about: Signalling of the high-speed lines rated at 15 trains an hour each way; Gare de Lyon short of departures at the evening peak

sncf_gtfs.publisher: SNCF, timetable open data (GTFS), published 13 October 2026
sncf_gtfs.about: Regional express and Intercités trains at the Paris terminals, busiest hour, counted for Tuesday 17 November 2026: Gare du Nord 11, Gare de l'Est 3, Montparnasse 6, Gare de Lyon with Bercy 3 (own count)
